import openpyxl, math
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/inputs/data.xlsx', data_only=True)
ws=wb['Sheet1']
rows=list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
header=rows[0]

for r in rows[1:]:
    if r[0] is not None and r[1] is not None and r[2] is not None and isinstance(r[3], (int,float)):
        data.append((r[1], r[2], float(r[3])))
print(len(data))
y=[1 if eff=='PR' else 0 for g,eff,age in data]
x=[age for g,eff,age in data]
print(sum(y), len(y)-sum(y), min(x),max(x),sum(x)/len(x))

def fit_logistic(x,y, tol=1e-15):
    n=len(x)
    beta=[0.0,0.0]
    for it in range(100):
        eta=[beta[0]+beta[1]*xi for xi in x]
        p=[1/(1+math.exp(-e)) for e in eta]
        w=[pi*(1-pi) for pi in p]
        z=[eta[i]+(y[i]-p[i])/w[i] if w[i]"'!=0 else eta[i] for i in range(n)]
        # solve weighted LS: sum w = s0, sum wx=sx, sum wxx=sxx; right sum wz, sum wxz
        s0=sum(w); sx=sum(w[i]*x[i] for i in range(n)); sxx=sum(w[i]*x[i]*x[i] for i in range(n))
        rz=sum(w[i]*z[i] for i in range(n)); rxz=sum(w[i]*x[i]*z[i] for i in range(n))
        det=s0*sxx-sx*sx
        b1=(s0*rxz-sx*rz)/det
        b0=(rz-sx*b1)/s0
        if abs(b0-beta[0])<tol and abs(b1-beta[1])<tol:
            break
        beta=[b0,b1]
    return beta,p,it
beta,p,it=fit_logistic(x,y)
print('"'beta',beta,'it',it)
# covariance via inverse information
n=len(x)
eta=[beta[0]+beta[1]*xi for xi in x]
p=[1/(1+math.exp(-e)) for e in eta]
w=[pi*(1-pi) for pi in p]
s0=sum(w); sx=sum(w[i]*x[i] for i in range(n)); sxx=sum(w[i]*x[i]*x[i] for i in range(n))
det=s0*sxx-sx*sx
var0=sxx/det; var1=s0/det
print('se b1', math.sqrt(var1), 'wald', beta[1]/math.sqrt(var1))
# log likelihood
ll=sum(y[i]*math.log(p[i])+(1-y[i])*math.log(1-p[i]) for i in range(n))
print('ll',ll)
# scipy? no
PY"
